title: Handlebars.js
definition: Handlebars provides the power necessary to let you build semantic templates effectively with no frustration. It enforces logic-less templates, meaning you use simple tags like `{{name}}` rather than writing complex JavaScript inside the HTML.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Handlebars.js?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
